what_it_probes: Implementing a byte-exact chunked columnar format v3 from a 390-line spec inside a 5,300-line, 50-module archive library: varint/zigzag, wrapping delta-of-delta timestamps, a byte-oriented float XOR encoding, dictionary strings, LSB-first validity bitmaps (v2 bools are MSB-first), smallest-encoding selection, conditional zlib, per-chunk CRCs, a footer index with first-occurrence min/max statistics, lazy opening and range queries that must not decompress skipped chunks or unneeded columns, nullable columns threaded through schema, table, CSV, JSON, stats, expressions and resample, schema evolution by add-column, about 60 exact corruption messages with chunk/column attributes, and info/verify/migrate CLI output, while keeping v1 and v2 reads and byte-exact writes.
